out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a FOOD PREPARATION SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: WHITE HAM AT 47- 52F, PINK HAM AT 48F, PATE AT 47F, PORK BELLY AT 51F, BBQ PORK AT 44F, IH-HOUSE MAYONNAISE AT 46F IN TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP; UNSALTED BUTTER AT 46F, WHITE HAM AT 45F, PINK HAM AT 46F, PORK ROLL AT 46F, BBQ PORK AT 45F, PATE AT 44F, COOKED CHICKEN AT 44F, COOKED PORK AT 45F, RAW PORK AT 44F RAW BEEF AT 46F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TCS) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. ALL TCS FOODS HELD FOR 4 OR MORE HOURS WERE DISCARDED. UNSALTED BUTTER, RAW BEEF AND RAW PORK WERE TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER OR OHTER REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. PEELED RADISH, STOCK POT OF DRIPPINGS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FOODS TO COUNTERS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP AT 48F; WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MANAGEMENT CALLED FOR SERVICE TECHNICIAN; EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO DISCARD ALL TCS FOODS HELD FOR 4 OR MORE HOURS IN REFRIGERATION UNITS. MANAGEMENT WILL CALL EHS FOR REOPENING ONCE UNITS ARE REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES A 41F OR BELOW.. Banh Mi Ong Beo (Inspection Date: 07/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT THE START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CLEANING, HANDLING THE BIN WITHOUT REMOVING GLOVES AND WASHING HANDS BEFORE PROCEEDING TO ENGAGE IN FOOD PREPARATION ACTIVITIES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES, AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES TO ENGAGE IN FOOD PREPARATION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE CONTINUED TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHING HANDS AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO DISCONTINUE AND WASH HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORTIONED STICKY RICE MEAL AT 67F ON FRONT SERVICE COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): PORTIONED STICKY RICE MEAL ON FRONT SERVICE COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL FORWARD DOCUMENTATION FOR PORTIONED STICKY RICE MEAL AND SHRIMP SPRING ROLLS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH FOODS IN BACK KITCHEN STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC AND EMPLOYEE RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, SAUCES IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE LABELS APPLIED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: INDUSTRIAL SPRAY BOTTLE USED FOR STORING WATER FOR DOUGH MAKING.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE USE AND UTILIZE ONLY NSF APPROVED FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS FOR STORAGE OF FOODS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS in the BEHIND AND UNDER EQUIPMENT AND SHELVING IN BACK STORAGE AREA, COOK LINE, COUNTERS, BAKING LINE ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED MAIN REFRIGERATION UNITS UNABLE TO MAINTAIN FOODS REQUIRING TIME OF TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY (TCS) AT 41F OR BELOW. ESTABLISHMENT IS UNABLE TO SUSTAIN OPERATIONS WITHOUT POTENTIAL RISK TO CONSUMERS WITHOUT ADEQUATE REFRIGERATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: OWNERSHIP VOLUNTARILY CLOSED AND WILL CALL EHS FOR FOLLOW UP INSPECTION ONCE REFRIGERATION UNITS HAVE BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE OPEN BEVERAGE ON COUNTER TOP NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO PLACE LID OVER OPEN CUP AND TO STORE EMPLOYEES BEVERAGE IN A DESIGNATED AREA.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HAND AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: BREAD WHILE PREPARING BEEF SANDWICH FOR CUSTOMER WITHOUT GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HAND AND PUT ON GLOVES TO PREPARE SANDWICHES FOR CUSTOMERS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED EMPLOYEES COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK is blocked WITH EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REMOVED ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED OVER TOFU IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MICE DROPPINGS IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PROVIDED LAST CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE REPORT OF 06/27/2025. PLEASE CLEAN AREAS AND PROVIDE CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the HOLES AND GAPS IN CEILING OVER OVEN EXHAUST; OVER FIRE SUPPRESSION SYSTEM; NEAR WATER HEATER.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE SEAL HOLES AND GAPS IN CEILING TO PREVENT ACCESS TO PEST. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO DISCLOSURE STATEMENT IN CONSUMER ADVISORY.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE UPDATE CONSUMER ADVISORY TO INCLUDE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean DOUGH MIXER found stored at the EMPLOYEE RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED TO REMOVE DOUGH MIXER SANITIZE AND FIND ALTERNATIVE STORAGE LOCATION.
